subject: Confirmation requested on the Section 31 50 00 setback requirement for the excavation

messages.text: At Pour 3, the geotechnical report doesn't clearly speak to the Section 31 50 00 setback requirement for the excavation shoring near the property line -- can the civil inspector sign off on it as shown? We'd like this confirmed ahead of the next civil inspection. Please respond within five days so we can schedule the civil inspection.
